name: Popover
purpose: Anchored floating list for the mention autocomplete at the caret. Holds ComboboxItem mention rows, shown only when the @ query has matches, at most 6 (maxItems). Focus stays in the editor throughout; the list is linked by aria-activedescendant. The formatting floating toolbar that the source groups with floating surfaces is not here (see notWidgets). Presentation is single, so no variant axis.
base: Radix Popover (Content with a virtual point anchor at the caret).

props.name: open
props.description: Shown when there are matches for the @ query.

props.name: anchor
props.description: Caret point; repositioned on scroll and resize.

props.name: onEscape
props.description: Closes the list; typed text stays in the editor.

states: open (matches for the @ query; listbox shown)
role: listbox, owned by the editor. The editor is the combobox and points at the active option with aria-activedescendant.
keyboard: ArrowUp and ArrowDown move the highlight. Enter or Tab picks the highlighted row. Escape closes the list and leaves the typed text; typing continues in the editor. Focus stays in the editor. Mousedown on a row picks it with preventDefault so focus stays in the editor.
platform: Same on both. Neither opens a window on desktop, and neither uses a backdrop. Web: the mousedown pick must not take focus from the editor (preventDefault).
open: 1) Layer: the reference uses z-tooltip (RichTextEditor.tsx:598-630); B's fold to z-dropdown is proposed here; a popover over the editor should not share the tooltip layer. Decision needed. 2) Width w-60 = 210px and max-h-56 = 196px are derived from 1rem=14px, not measured; confirm. 3) The look is not measured; values come from component code. 4) The toolbar's focus and keyboard model moved with it to the Toolbar family (see notWidgets).
